title: digraph
description: `digraph` creates a directed graph compatibility object with `Nodes` and `Edges` tables. It supports edge-list construction with numeric or named nodes, optional weights, optional node names, and dense adjacency matrices.

signatures.label: G = digraph(s, t)
signatures.description: Create a directed graph from source and target node vectors.

signatures.label: G = digraph(A)
signatures.description: Create a directed graph from a square dense adjacency matrix where `A(i,j)` is edge `i -> j`.

gpu_residency: No. Directed graph construction and traversal are host metadata/control-flow operations.
